value.ablation: When a round trains several strategies, dev selects one. Test results for the others are analysis only and never change the decision.
caveats: The frozen test is evaluated once per round, so later rounds carry multiple-comparison risk; each round's fresh holdout is the check against that
Synthetic templates measure this task only; no claim about other tasks or real user traffic follows

dimension_basis.determinism: 1.0: static repository JSON; every build yields identical bytes
dimension_basis.evidence_grounding: share of declared references that resolve to records in this pack; a noun without references is self-contained (1.0)
dimension_basis.safety_compliance: share of pack safety checks passed: no secret-like strings, private visibility, no public effect, nothing activated
dimension_basis.token_efficiency: 1 - canonical value bytes / 65536, the per-record budget this pack keeps; floor 0

promotion.baseline: the current champion; before any promotion, the unchanged base model
promotion.effects: Moves only the private local champion pointer that the next round compares against. No deployment, publication, admission or serving change.

no_regression.name: test JSON validity does not drop more than 0.02
test schema validity does not drop more than 0.02
test refusal accuracy does not drop more than 0.03
sanity accuracy does not drop more than 0.05 against the champion
sanity accuracy stays within 0.10 of the unchanged base
fresh holdout exact match does not drop below the champion

selection.note: Dev chooses among candidates; the frozen test is read only for the dev winner's decision
